findings.governingReading: The armored third Servant remains grammatically unidentified while evoking someone Shirou knows.
findings.explanation: The English prematurely reveals a female gender.

findings.highlight: swings through empty space, smashing down into the ground
findings.evidenceJa: 虚しく宙を切り、地面を吹き飛ばす
findings.governingReading: Berserker’s blow cuts futilely through empty air and blasts the ground away.
findings.explanation: The English turns the resulting ground destruction into the weapon smashing downward into it.

findings.highlight: makes her way through Berserker’s sword and the flying clods and attacks at his defenseless body
findings.evidenceJa: 大剣と土塊をすり抜け、無防備な体を一閃する
findings.governingReading: The black knight slips through sword and earth clods and cuts Berserker’s exposed body in one stroke.
findings.explanation: The English is malformed and loses evasion, precision, and completed attack.

findings.evidenceJa: あらゆる攻撃を無効化しかねない
findings.governingReading: Berserker’s steel body is capable of nullifying any kind of attack.
findings.explanation: The English changes potential universality into reliable protection against merely most attacks.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=きゃつ char=2]彼奴に囚われて
findings.governingReading: Zouken says escape is impossible once Berserker is caught by that entity.
findings.explanation: The English changes one captor into encirclement by the entire group.

findings.evidenceJa: 嘲笑う声は間桐臓硯のものか
findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively identifies the mocking voice as Zouken’s.
findings.explanation: The English removes the focalized uncertainty.

findings.highlight: his entire body covered in black
findings.evidenceJa: 全身を黒いものに侵食されたバーサーカー
findings.governingReading: Black matter has invaded or corroded Berserker’s entire body.
findings.explanation: The English reduces active bodily incursion to surface covering.

findings.governingReading: Black vines extend from the mire and bind Berserker.
findings.explanation: The English changes external plantlike restraints into anatomical veins.

findings.highlight: he still stands against the swordsman
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い剣士と互角に戦っている
findings.governingReading: Despite being engulfed, Berserker fights the black knight on equal terms.

findings.evidenceJa: 苦もなく地面を駆け、バーサーカーを一刀する
findings.governingReading: The black knight races effortlessly across the ground and cuts Berserker in one completed stroke.
findings.explanation: The English removes ease and converts a successful cut into an attack directed at him.

findings.governingReading: The black knight may equal or exceed Berserker in Servant ability.

findings.evidenceJa: 呆然と、感情のない声で
findings.governingReading: Illya speaks in a stunned daze and without emotion as she begs Berserker to flee.
findings.explanation: The English omits the shock that explains her flattened voice.

findings.highlight: his body bound by the black shadow
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い影に体を侵食されたバーサーカー
findings.governingReading: The black shadow has invaded or eroded Berserker’s body, in addition to binding it.
findings.explanation: The English removes bodily incursion and repeats restraint alone.

findings.highlight: going deep enough to expose his bones
findings.evidenceJa: 中身が覗こうという勢いで
findings.governingReading: He strips away his own body with such force that the inside seems about to show.
findings.explanation: The English makes exposure completed and conditionally invents bones as the exposed anatomy.

findings.highlight: It will be his last attack
findings.evidenceJa: おそらくは最後の一撃
findings.governingReading: The narration estimates that this is probably Berserker’s final blow.
findings.explanation: The English promotes the estimate into certain futurity.

findings.governingReading: The black knight meets Berserker’s blow with her strongest attack.
findings.explanation: The English removes the superlative that establishes the clash’s intended hierarchy.
